docs.name: ops-kv-cache.md
docs.description: KV cache reuse and prefix caching
docs.content: Transformer serving latency depends heavily on KV-cache reuse across requests. Prefix caching shares the common system prompt blocks, cutting time-to-first-token by 40 percent under bursty traffic. Cache eviction must respect reference counts held by in-flight completions.

docs.name: ops-graphrag.md
docs.content: GraphRAG indexing pipelines extract entities with an LLM, then build a community hierarchy via Leiden clustering. Community summaries answer global questions that plain vector retrieval misses, at the cost of a one-time indexing bill paid per corpus version.

docs.name: ops-bm25-tokenizer.md
docs.content: BM25 remains a strong first-stage retriever for entity-heavy queries. Jieba tokenization matters for Chinese mixed text: whitespace splitting destroys compound nouns and halves recall at rank five in our logs.

docs.name: ops-fresh-reindex.md
docs.content: Knowledge base freshness requires re-indexing on every document update. Force re-index clears stale vector collections but leaves in-memory BM25 indexes dirty across rebuild generations, so long-lived backends must restart after bulk deletions before scoped search is trusted again.

docs.name: ops-experience-tiers.md
docs.content: Experience entries distilled from operations need credibility tiers. Entries applied three times with positive feedback get promoted, while unapplied entries decay after thirty days and are demoted, never deleted, preserving an auditable lifecycle for agent-facing knowledge.

docs.name: ops-ocr-layout.md
docs.content: OCR quality bounds retrieval quality for scanned PDFs. Layout-aware parsing keeps table structure readable, and paragraph coordinates enable structure-aware agents to navigate long documents like human readers do.
